title: Agent message (DRAFT)
description: PRELIMINARY DRAFT protocol between the Java/iFogSim simulator and the Python Q-Learning agent. NOT an agreed contract. Field names, units, and encodings are provisional and require agreement between Ayoub (simulator) and Ibrahim (agent). This schema accepts EITHER a request (simulator -> agent) OR a response (agent -> simulator) via oneOf. It does not describe a working implementation.

categoricalBand.description: PROVISIONAL categorical band. Exact discretization boundaries and their units are undecided and must be documented by the team.

request.title: State request (simulator -> agent)
request.description: Illustrative request. Each measured feature may be sent either as a raw numeric value (units TBD) or as a documented categorical band; the team must pick one representation and document it.

task_id.description: PROVISIONAL field name. Unique identifier for the task; must be echoed back by the agent so outcomes can be linked to the original task.

task_size.description: PROVISIONAL. Task size, either a raw numeric value (unit TBD, e.g. MB) or a categorical band. The chosen encoding must be documented.

network_latency.description: PROVISIONAL. Observed network latency, either a raw numeric value (units MUST be documented, e.g. milliseconds) or a categorical band.

edge_utilization.description: PROVISIONAL. Edge node utilization, either a raw numeric value (unit TBD: fraction 0-1 or percentage 0-100) or a categorical band.

deadline_category.description: PROVISIONAL. Deadline band for the task. The rule mapping raw deadlines to these categories is undecided.

response.title: Action response (agent -> simulator)
response.description: The agent's selected placement action. The simulator must actually apply this action and independently verify the real execution destination.

task_id.description: Must echo the task_id from the corresponding request.

action.description: Selected offloading action for the task.
